name: 99163 · Pullman, WA
findings: ZIP 99163 (Pullman) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99163 (Pullman) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
